- src-tauri/tests/ipc_contract_tests.rs drives the real Rust struct in
Every value is deliberately NON-DEFAULT. A field that one side maps and the
other does not comes back as its default, and the assertion fails naming the
field. That is the whole point: this project has twice shipped a settings
field mapped in one direction only, which passes any test that only checks
the direction it was written in.
`settings` is simultaneously the UI view, the patch the UI emits for a
full-section write, and the document Rust stores — the three shapes are one
shape on purpose, so there is nothing to keep in sync by hand.
_preset_patch_comment: §14.6. Choosing a preset moves the band. Sending only `pacePreset` would
leave Rust holding the previous numbers alongside a preset that contradicts
them, and the rail would score the take against a band the user did not
pick. The band therefore travels with the control that decided it.
_clear_patch_comment: Clearing an optional value must be sent as null, not omitted. Rust's
merge_json removes a key whose patch value is null and the container-level
serde `default` refills it with None — a clear. Omitting the key instead
